data.headline: Site Reliability Engineering & Service Delivery Manager @ Wipro | Cross-functional Team Leadership
data.about:
As a Site Reliability Engineering & Service Delivery Manager at Wipro, contributed over three years of expertise to delivering operational excellence in cloud and data center operations for a leading global technology client. Focused on driving automation, governance, and stakeholder collaboration, successfully implemented strategies that reduced incident volume by 80% and achieved zero manual interventions. Developed structured review frameworks to ensure seamless service delivery across geographies while optimizing infrastructure performance and availability.  

With 14+ years of experience spanning cloud computing, infrastructure management, and customer support, enabled large-scale service transformations through process optimization and strategic leadership. Partnered with cross-functional teams to onboard high-visibility projects and design knowledge management frameworks that enhanced service reliability. Dedicated to aligning technical solutions with business goals to foster growth, improve resiliency, and deliver lasting value to clients.

Gained deep expertise in global hiring policies, including TUPE compliance in EMEA and navigating critical APAC locations. 
Led a seamless go-live process while maintaining service excellence and operational efficiency.
Leading initiatives in capacity management, hardware refresh, and device health alerting to enhance service performance and scalability. 
Driving automation and engineering excellence across networking services, ensuring seamless operations and infrastructure resilience.

I played a pivotal role in enhancing Site Reliability and Operations support at Mindtree.  

• Spearheaded operations for Windows Azure, integrating engineering and customer experience services.  
• Drove incident management for Bing and Cortana, ensuring prompt resolution and operational efficiency.  
• Collaborated with Power BI Service to improve service reliability and supportability program management.

•	Providing configuration support for datacenter environment consisting of Cisco routers, Juniper Routers, L2/L3 switches, F5 Load Balancers & Juniper Firewalls.
•	Implementing changes like ACL creation, addition of policies on Firewalls on Juniper through NSM (Network Security Manager).
•	Following Standard Operation Procedure (ITIL Foundation) while creating and implementing the Change requests.
•	Handling business critical change tickets.
